theme: Setting internal prices that survive an audit
title: Comparable Set Defense: Pricing an Intercompany Margin for Audit
strategies: closest-by-plain-distance baseline: MIN_COMPS candidates picked at a fixed stride through the listed order, no documentation, declared margin = plain average (checker's own internal baseline)

aggressive cherry-pick: screen candidates by loose overall (unweighted) similarity, then chase the highest reported margins, spend zero documentation budget, declare near the top of the hand-picked set's own range

robust hedge: select the broad set of candidates that are close on EVERY functional axis (not just on average), spend the documentation budget defending the weakest-fit members, declare a defensible position near the 65th-75th percentile of that broad, representative pool -- not the narrow cherry-picked one
invalid: emit a doc-depth or index out of range / budget-violating artifact
